title: 第19章 案卷分析第20章 文娱休闲活动
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
晚上！
夏辰回到家中，原本夏辰今天晚上去宵禁巡街，但一问这才得知，分配到他手下两营的宵禁任务前两天便已完成。
所以今晚自然无事，又不能去勾栏听曲，所以干脆回到家中。
“少爷！”
夏辰进入自己房间没多久，夏千的声音便在房外响起。
“进来！”
“少爷，你要的关于大庆暗探的资料要过来了！”
夏千拿着一叠资料走了进来，这份资料是羽林卫的内部资料，夏辰现在是校尉，有资格调动。
最近这一个月，京城局势有些动荡，听说都直达圣听，引得圣上大怒。
提灯人出动，在京城已经抓捕了很多人，引得现在京城百姓人心惶惶。
“西北军防图被盗？”
夏辰翻开资料卷宗，这才明白究竟发生了何事。
大武国西北边境与大庆大奉接壤，这里驻扎着20万边军，但现在，军防图竟然被盗，这事情就严重了，难怪皇帝都会动怒，直接调动提灯人出手，在京城大肆抓人。
“这么重要的军防图，竟然有人从兵部直接拿出，当时没有惊动任何人，看来兵部是有内鬼呀！”
夏辰看着卷宗喃喃自语，这几十年来，大武和大庆大奉一直争斗不休，但除了36年前与大奉的淮阳之战之外，一直没有大规模战争，只是边境小有摩擦。
而现在西北军防图被偷，这显然可能会引发大动荡。
大奉36年过去，想来已经恢复元气，自淮阳之战之后，大庆和大奉两国便越走越近，颇有一种合纵抗武之势！
夏辰想到这些，接着往下看去。
卷宗上写着，军防图由兵部一小吏偷出，之后交给了京城西城一个铁匠手中，提灯人掌握这条消息之后，去往这小吏和铁匠家中时，发现这两人早已自尽。
消息到这里便断了。

“六七天过去了，军防图肯定已经被传了出去，看来西北那边的形势会有大变化了！”
夏辰若有所思，无论是否能将大庆暗探给揪出来，那份军防图肯定是丢了。
说不定都已经传回大庆国都了。
“那一名小吏和铁匠之间，肯定最少还有一个中间人，但这个中间人，在卷宗中却没有提及，是遗漏了还是有人故意隐藏了？”
夏辰很快从卷宗中，发现了一丝蹊跷，那名小吏，能够进出兵部，甚至能够从兵部核心中将这份军防图给偷出来，仅凭他一个人肯定是完不成这些的。
而且夏辰注意到，那名兵部小吏住在北城靠内城，而那名铁匠住在西城边缘区域。
两者的直线距离都有20里以上，绝对不可能是那名小吏亲手将军防图交给铁匠的。
“晚上无论是内城还是外城，都是要宵禁的，除非有特别通行令牌，否则无论是谁，都不能行走，而军防图正是晚上走丢的……”
夏辰躺在床上，思考着这些，晚上能够自由行走的，唯有禁军和提灯人，这说明，禁军和提灯人都有嫌疑，甚至，严重的，这两方都被渗透了。
夏辰抽丝剥茧，想到了很多东西，但奈何手中的信息实在太有限了，他只能从案卷中分析出这些，而且他怀疑这份案卷并不完整。
提灯人那里一定掌握了更多消息，他们无论是办案还是侦探，都是专业的。
content_en:
night!
Xia Chen returned home. Originally, Xia Chen went to patrol the streets during the curfew tonight, but after asking, he learned that the curfew tasks assigned to his two battalions had been completed two days ago.
So of course I had nothing to do tonight, and I couldn't go to Goulan to listen to music, so I just went home.
"Master!"
Not long after Xia Chen entered his room, Xia Qian's voice sounded outside the room.
"Come in!"
"Master, the information you requested about Daqing's spies is coming!"
Xia Qian walked in with a stack of information. This information was the internal information of Yulin Guard. Xia Chen was now a captain and was eligible for transfer.
In the past month, the situation in the capital has been somewhat turbulent. People who heard about it went directly to the Holy Spirit, which made the Holy Spirit furious.
The lantern-carrying men were dispatched and many people were arrested in the capital, causing panic among the people in the capital.
"The northwest military defense map was stolen?"
Xia Chen opened the information file and realized what happened.
The northwest border of Dawu Kingdom borders Dafeng, Daqing. There are 200,000 border troops stationed here. But now, the military defense map has been stolen. This matter is serious. No wonder the emperor is angry and directly mobilizes the lantern bearer to arrest people in the capital.
"Someone actually took out such an important military defense map directly from the Ministry of War. No one was alerted at the time. It seems that there is an insider in the Ministry of War!"
Xia Chen looked at the files and muttered to himself, Dawu and Daqing Dafeng had been fighting endlessly for decades, but except for the battle of Huaiyang with Dafeng 36 years ago, there had never been large-scale wars, only minor frictions on the border.
And now that the northwest military defense map has been stolen, this may obviously cause great turmoil.
Thirty-six years have passed since Dafeng, and I think it has recovered its strength. Since the Battle of Huaiyang, Daqing and Dafeng have become closer and closer, and they have a tendency to join forces to fight against each other!
Xia Chen thought of this and then looked down.
The file said that the military defense map was stolen by a small official in the Ministry of War, and then handed over to a blacksmith in the west city of the capital. After grasping this news, the lantern holder went to the house of the small official and the blacksmith, and found that the two men had already committed suicide.
The news stopped here.
"Six or seven days have passed, and the military defense map must have been circulated. It seems that the situation in the northwest will change greatly!"
Xia Chen thought thoughtfully. Regardless of whether he could uncover the Daqing spy, the military defense map must have been lost.
Maybe it has already spread back to the capital of Daqing.
"There must be at least one middleman between the clerk and the blacksmith, but this middleman is not mentioned in the file. Was it omitted or was it deliberately hidden?"
Xia Chen quickly discovered something strange from the files. That small official was able to enter and leave the Ministry of War, and could even steal the military defense map from the core of the Ministry of War. He would definitely not be able to accomplish this by himself.
Moreover, Xia Chen noticed that the military official lived in the inner city of the North City, while the blacksmith lived in the edge of the West City.
The straight-line distance between the two is more than 20 miles. It is absolutely impossible for the clerk to personally hand over the general defense map to the blacksmith.
"Whether it's the inner city or the outer city, there is a curfew at night. Unless there is a special pass, no one can walk, and the military defense map was lost at night..."
Xia Chen was lying on the bed, thinking about this. The only people who could walk freely at night were the Forbidden Army and the Lantern Man. This showed that both the Imperial Guard and the Lantern Man were suspected, and even more seriously, both parties had been infiltrated.
Xia Chen scratched his head and thought of many things, but the information in his hands was too limited. He could only analyze this from the case file, and he suspected that the case file was incomplete.
The Lantern Man must have more information. They are all professionals in handling cases and detectives.
